identification_class: 18 disjoint CM translational mass-projection partitions, covering r^T M r; not full FE mass or stiffness identification

inputs.A: R by18 signed CM UX rows; use a single length unit
inputs.f: same-mode same-sign same-scale generalized load projections, up to one common nonzero conversion
inputs.modal_mass: complete phi^T M phi, same modal scale as A
inputs.mu: same-direction effective modal mass / total unconstrained direction mass; fraction not percent

equations.reference: j=argmax(abs(f)); require f_j resolved and nonzero
equations.relative_mass: If nullity=1 with admissible sign, w=v/sum(v)

PF_gate: If field is Gamma, use m_r*Gamma as mass projection after unit conversion; original H needs common m_r or an explicitly equivalent normalization.

modal_scaling_law.result: H rows scale by a_r; w and M_r unchanged

units_given_in_request.warning: Do not label the converted generalized mass kg; global unit errors survive across-mode consistency.

rank_gate.rank_below_17: not unique without new independent physical constraints
rank_gate.rank_18: no exact nonzero common-projection mass solution
rank_gate.report: all18 singular values, precision-induced error bound epsilon_H, residual, reference-change and source-rounding perturbation sensitivity
rank_gate.near_null: smallest singular value compatible with noise and next singular value separated above noise; a lone SVD vector is not sufficient
rank_gate.row_scaling: If used, predeclare it and propagate errors in that metric; do not promote precision-zero rows.

positivity_gate: One global sign flip allowed; no clipping mixed signs; require positive mass where independently known to exist.
zero_rows: f_r=0 still supplies A_r*m=0; do not discard solely because participation is zero.
zero_total_scale: mu=0 and A*w=0 gives0/0; all-zero f cannot select a reference or supply absolute mass from these ratios.

uncertainty.exclusion: Use source precision before comparing M_r; do not select modes to obtain agreement.

counterconditions: A_r=f_r*a^T gives H=0 and nonidentifiable partitions.
A hidden mass whose observed shape is a combination of CM columns can be absorbed into apparent CM masses; even exact rank and consistent total mass cannot prove spatial coverage.
CM-only per-mode normalization with unchanged PF or modal mass violates the common-scale law.
data_read: Only frozen small theory notes; no raw/model/response table extraction
